thread:
Rae (Sales): warm handoff for Orpheon Labs. Midmarket, 90-day pilot, 4 seats. They want Okta SSO, EU private eval (eu-west), Splunk audit forwarding, and S3 audit export. Renewal approx 10 months. Marta can you own? Contract: https://redwood.at/orpheon-pilot

Marta (CS): on it. whos the tech contact and any immediate compliance notes?

Rae (Sales): tech contact is "Luca Romano" (luca@orpheon.ai). Pilot uses synthetic data, but they asked about HIPAA readiness later. Flag security.

Diego (Infra): to provision private eval need CIDRs, peering choice, and mTLS cert. Splunk requires HEC token and egress to splunk.collector.orpheon.io:8088. S3 export needs bucket ARN + role.

Sam (Support Eng): Splunk prefers JSON. I'll draft minimal mapping and a short troubleshooting checklist (HEC token, cert chain, firewall). Any preferred kickoff windows CET?

Ivy (Onboarding PM): I can schedule. Suggest 25-min tech kickoff + 45-min enablement. Marta, Tue morning CET work?

Marta (CS): yes. Owners proposed: Luca -> send CIDRs/cert/HEC token/S3 info; Rae -> confirm Okta metadata; Diego -> provision once assets received (will open INF ticket); Sam -> runbook + checklist; Ivy -> schedule invites; Marta -> pilot feedback doc + Gainsight renewal tag.

Rae (Sales): pinged Luca; he said assets by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: INF-10234 created: provision-private-eval-orpheon (assigned: Diego)

Diego (Infra): I'll wait for CIDRs then update INF-10234. infra snippet: redwoodctl create private --region eu-west-1 --profile orpheon-pilot --size m8g

Sam (Support Eng): will post runbook link when ready and include S3->Splunk export option.

Marta (CS): summary: owners noted, renewal owner Rae in Gainsight, pilot doc & feedback form in Confluence (I'll create), Ivy will send invites after assets arrive. I'll email Luca the owners & next steps. :white_check_mark:
